text: [160] pañcime bhikkhave uppannā duppaṭivinodayā katame pañca uppanno rāgo duppaṭivinodayo uppanno doso duppaṭivinodayo uppanno moho duppaṭivinodayo uppannaṃ paṭibhāṇaṃ duppaṭivinodayaṃ uppannaṃ gamikacittaṃ duppaṭivinodayaṃ ime kho bhikkhave pañca uppannā duppaṭivinodayāti . saddhammavaggo paṭhamo . tassuddānaṃ tayo saddhammaniyāmā 1 tayo saddhammasammosā dukkathā ceva sārajjaṃ 2 udāyi dubbinodayāti . ________________ #1 ma. sammattaniyāmā . 2 yu. sārajjaṃ ceva . āghātavaggo dutiyo
